Chris seemed like a very nice and genuine guy. However, I think his business practices are a little scammy. I found his number on Google and called to get a quote for an interior cleaning for my Kia Soul with dog hair. Chris said he charges $150 and that dog hair was included. He said he could come out immediately to take a look. As soon as he arrived, he began taking things out of his van and started cleaning. Halfway through vacuuming I asked how much it would be now that he's seen the car, he stuck with $150, stating that he usually charges for dog hair, but he's got me covered this time, even though he said the cost already covers dog hair on the phone. I found his website, where it says a "Basic Full Wash" is $140, which includes basic interior cleaning and an exterior wash. I paid $150 for just a very basic interior cleaning. Chris was done cleaning in literally less than 45 minutes. No other car cleaning or detailing company I've looked at can complete a semi-thorough cleaning under an hour. After inspecting my car, there's still dog hair in the backseat that wasn't vacuumed up. He didn't bother to wipe down the underside of my steering wheel area. The brake and gas pedal weren't touched, and there was stuff left unvaccumed behind them.  Additionally, the cleaner/conditioner he used on all the plastic in my car is very greasy and has made everything slick. I appreciate his friendliness, but not his cleanliness. Look elsewhere if you're wanting more
than a mediocre job.

Response to owner: The price isn't the issue, it's the quality of work. I have no problem paying for a job well done. However, charging $150 for there to still be a significant amount of dog hair, dirt, and untouched spots in my car is ridiculous. You call yourself "the best", but I could've done a better job with my own vacuum and rags. Do better.
